title: Cheese & Potato Balls
description: Cheese & Potato Balls are crispy golden appetizers made with creamy mashed potatoes, cheese, herbs, and a crunchy breadcrumb coating. They are served hot with marinara, cheese dip, or a creamy sauce, making them a perfect Continental starter.

ingredients.title: For the Potato Mixture
items: Mozzarella cheese – 100 g, cut into small cubes

ingredients.title: For Frying & Garnish
items: Fresh parsley or chives – for garnish
Marinara sauce, cheese dip, or creamy sauce – for serving

instruction.title: Step 1 – Prepare the Potato Mixture
steps: Boil potatoes until tender. Drain and mash smoothly; ensure no lumps.
Add butter, garlic paste, cream cheese, grated Parmesan, herbs, nutmeg, salt, and pepper. Mix until creamy.
Let the mixture cool slightly for easier handling.

instruction.title: Step 2 – Shape the Balls
steps: Take a small portion of the potato mixture (about 1–2 tbsp) in your hand.
Flatten slightly, place a cube of mozzarella in the center, and gently roll to enclose the cheese completely.
Roll into a smooth ball, about the size of a golf ball.

instruction.title: Step 3 – Coat the Balls
steps: Set up a breading station: flour (optional), beaten eggs, and breadcrumb mixture (breadcrumbs + Parmesan + paprika).
Roll each potato ball in egg, then coat evenly with the breadcrumb mixture.
For extra crunch, double coat by dipping in egg and breadcrumbs again.

instruction.title: Step 4 – Fry to Perfection
steps: Fry balls in batches until golden brown and crispy (approx. 3–4 mins).
Remove with a slotted spoon and drain on paper towels.

instruction.title: Step 5 – Presentation
steps: Sprinkle with fresh parsley or chives.
Serve hot with a small portion of marinara, cheese dip, or creamy sauce on the side.
Optional: Drizzle lightly with truffle oil for an upscale twist.

servingSuggestions.title: Serving Suggestions
items: Serve hot with marinara sauce, cheese dip, or a creamy sauce.
Garnish with fresh parsley or chives.
Pair with a fresh green salad for a complete starter.

chefTips: Ensure mashed potatoes are smooth; lumps make rolling difficult.
Mix cheeses for flavor—mozzarella for melt, Parmesan for sharpness.
Panko crumbs give a light, crunchy coating. Double coating ensures crunch.
Use a small ice cream scoop for consistent ball size.
Assemble balls and freeze on a tray, then fry directly from frozen for catering or service prep.
